page_title: Tire pressure sensor configuration and use
page_content:
[TOC]

### Installation list
| Name | Quantity | Name | Quantity |
| ------------ | ------------ |------------ | ------------ |
| MDVR device | 1 | MDVR 232 IO harness | 1 |
| Remote controller | 1 | Display | 1 |
| Tire pressure sensor | 1 | Common wiring tools | n |

### Necessary instructions
- Here we take **YAT-232** as an example. For other 232 protocol models, please refer to the following 232 wiring
- Tire pressure of some manufacturers may need to be debugged and connected before use

** Actual picture**:
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=2e97b5b698bf976a193e8423ef2490ba)
**YAT-232**

### Operation steps
#### 1. Wiring
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=1fceeda3e46f89905dffb162ab37a685)

#### 2. Device menu configuration
Remote control to enter menu>>Settings>>Serial port settings>>Serial port, serial port index configuration RS232, serial port function TPMS , protocol type type1, other parameters default, confirm to save and restart the device to take effect.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=dc05def0b0b2601bf38979bc1f3ceb37)

#### 3. Tire pressure test
After restarting, press the remote control direction key to go to the serial port status to check whether it is connected
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=2e8813ae8cef5e3303449eb3bfa4275b)
